authorization.title: Add a DingTalk Group Robot
authorization.description: Add a custom robot in the DingTalk group settings, choose “Signature” as the security setting, then enter the group name, webhook URL and signing secret. Each connection maps to one group; add multiple connections to send to different groups. Authorization only checks the format and sends no message; a wrong URL or secret is reported on the first send.
authorization.group_name.label: Group Name
authorization.group_name.description: Distinguishes connections and is used to choose the target group when sending
authorization.webhook_url.label: Webhook URL
authorization.webhook_url.description: The custom robot webhook URL, starting with https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=
authorization.secret.label: Signing Secret
authorization.secret.description: The secret generated by the robot's “Signature” security setting, starting with SEC
name: DingTalk Group Robot
description: Send text or Markdown messages to a DingTalk group through a custom robot webhook, with @mentions for members or everyone.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.text.title: Send text messages
capabilities.text.description: Send plain text to the group and @mention members by mobile number or user ID, or @everyone.
capabilities.markdown.title: Send Markdown messages
capabilities.markdown.description: Send Markdown with a title, lists, links and images, also with @mentions.
capabilities.info.title: View connection info
capabilities.info.description: View the group name and supported message types of this connection without contacting DingTalk or sending a message.
limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Only custom robots using the “Signature” security setting are supported; if custom keywords are also set, the message must contain a keyword. Each robot can send at most 20 messages per minute and is throttled by DingTalk for 10 minutes when exceeded. Every send requires confirmation and is never retried automatically; after a timeout, check the group before sending again.
examples.title: Examples
examples.notice.title: Send a notice
examples.notice.description: Tell the R&D Weekly group that tonight's release starts at 8 PM and @everyone.
examples.report.title: Send a daily report
examples.report.description: Summarize today's project progress in Markdown and send it to the project group.
